question.text: The Development Monitoring and Evaluation Office (DMEO) at NITI Ayog has set up panels of expert agencies in how many sectors, per Chapter 7.2.1?

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 7.2.1 explicitly states: 'DMEO has set up a panel with expert agencies in six sectors – Agriculture & Allied Sectors, Economic Sector, Energy Sector, Infrastructure Sector, Social Sector and Social Welfare Sector and their sub sectors.' The Trap: The six-sector number is factual and often mis-remembered as four. Candidates may also confuse it with the 16 eligible SSE activities under SEBI ICDR 292B — completely different count. Cross-Exam Context: DMEO structure is referenced in public-policy evaluation literature; adjacent to World Bank DIME structure cited in Ch 7.2.2. Assessor's Pro-Tip: If a client asks you to bid on a DMEO panel empanelment, the six-sector taxonomy determines which sub-sector your practice qualifies for. Align your SAS-empanellment portfolio with the DMEO sub-sectors to cross-qualify.
